title: EJ Obiena Keeps Winning and His Socks Keep Getting More Colorful!
summary: Filipino athletes are taking the phrase “put your best foot forward” to a whole new level. From EJ Obiena’s colorful socks to Alex Eala’s ruffled pairs, socks might just be our newest lucky charm.
